opening.argument: The presentation ties earnings to recruiting and network performance. It explicitly says direct sales generate commissions when a viewer refers someone, while additional earnings are calculated from volume on the lesser team leg. The package promotion further links a 5,030-euro purchase to a claimed account value of 24,000 euros, presenting substantial account growth as a reason to participate. The speaker urges viewers not to miss the program or business, and the closing slide calls them to partner with the team. Taken together, the presentation promotes paid packages through referral commissions, weaker-side network bonuses, and a recruitment-dependent compensation structure, while encouraging participation through projected account growth.
